'''Grelli Cryko''' was a [[Melitto]] [[Homeworld|from]] the [[planet]] [[Li-Toran]]. In [[9 BBY]], Cryko drank in a [[Unidentified saloon|saloon]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the planet [[Tatooine]]. While Cryko was there, three [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]] entered the establishment in [[Search for Nari|search]] of the [[Jedi]] [[Nari]], who they lured out of hiding by threatening the [[Unidentified saloon owner|saloon owner]]. Nari then fled from the [[Cantina|saloon]].

==Biography==
Grelli Cryko was a [[Melitto]] from the [[planet]] [[Li-Toran]]<ref name="Topps" /> who spent [[time]] on the [[desert]] planet [[Tatooine]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Kenobi I">{{Kenobi|Part I}}</ref> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part I}} to [[9 BBY]].</ref> Cryko was seated at a table with a drink in a [[Unidentified saloon|saloon]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] when three Imperial [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]] [[Search for Nari|entered]] the establishment. The Melitto stayed seated while the leader of the trio, [[the Grand Inquisitor]], questioned the [[Unidentified saloon owner|saloon owner]] about rumors of a [[Jedi]] hiding in the building.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

[[File:GrelliCryko-Kenobi.png|thumb|right|300px|Grelli Cryko encountered the Grand Inquisitor on Tatooine.]]
The [[Inquisitor]] known as the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] then threw a [[knife]] at the owner, forcing the Jedi fugitive [[Nari]] to reveal himself among the patrons when he used [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|stop]] the [[Melee weapon|weapon]] in mid-air. Having found their quarry, the Inquisitors closed in, but after the [[Grand Inquisitor]] stopped the Third [[Sister (Inquisitorius)|Sister]] from [[Death|executing]] Nari, the Jedi fled from the [[Cantina|saloon]] and the Imperials gave chase, leaving Cryko and the others in their seats. Cryko later walked past the Jedi-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] while carrying a container outside<ref name="Kenobi I" /> a checkpoint at Mos Eisley spaceport.<ref name="Audio">{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As a cold-[[blood]]ed Melitto, Cryko loved Tatooine's [[Temperature|hot]] desert climes. They had [[Color|green]], yellow, and tan plating.<ref name="Topps" />

==Equipment==
While in Mos Eisley, Cryko wore a gray hooded [[jacket]] with a yellow chestpiece and black [[glove]]s. Tubes ran from the chestpiece to Cryko's face and the chestpiece had two white cylinders mounted on the back. When passing Kenobi, the Melitto carried a flat, gray case.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I can confirm that I was cast as Grelli Cryko (at the time, we just called the character by its species name "Melitto") and I played this character in the first epsiode of Obi-Wan Kenobi. 90% of the screentime it's me in the costume, but the actor Rory Ross covered for me for a couple extra days on set because I was also filming The Book of Boba Fett at the time and I had to be two places at once.|Greg Kufera|<ref name="Instagram">[[:File:GregKufera-GrelliCryko.png|Instagram message from Greg Kufera]] — Used with permission</ref>}}
Grelli Cryko appeared in the [[Part I|first episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series,<ref name="Kenobi I" /> which aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}}</ref> During production, the character was simply refered to as Melitto and was primarily performed by [[Greg Kufera]], although [[Rory Ross]] also played the character during several extra days of filming when Kufera was unavaliable while filming for the ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'' television series.<ref name="Instagram" /> The character was not identified in the series<ref name="Kenobi I" /> but received a name on a card in the [[2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|2023 Topps ''Star Wars Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] set released by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] in [[2023]].<ref name="Topps" />
